name: Mira
description: A young woman in her early twenties, bright, clear and hopeful, with a breathless, energetic quality as if she has just been running. Warm, natural, expressive and a little eager. American accent. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: I made it, I actually made it! I know the road was long and everyone told me I would never get here, but I did, and I am not going to stop now. Come on, let's go before the gates close.
script: [breathless, excited] I made it! Did you see that? I actually made it! [angry, frustrated] No. You don't get to decide that for me. I'm not a child anymore! [softly, vulnerable] ...I'm just scared. But I'll do it anyway.

moods.calm: [calm, friendly] Hi. I was just heading into town, if you want to walk with me.
moods.joy: [delighted, laughing] Oh, it's wonderful! I can't believe it actually worked. Thank you!
moods.anger: [furious, shouting] How dare you! I trusted you, and you lied to my face!
moods.fear: [terrified, whispering, trembling] Did you hear that? Something's out there. Please, don't leave me alone.
moods.sadness: [sorrowful, tearful, quiet] I really thought we'd make it home. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.
moods.seductive: [playful, warm, flirtatious] Oh, don't look at me like that. You'll make a girl blush.

name: Old Maud
description: An elderly grandmother, a very old WOMAN with a female voice, seventy-five or older, rasping, crackly and wheezy, slow and mischievous, like a village witch who knows everyone's secrets. Thin aged voice with a cunning edge and a dry cackle. English countryside accent.
preview_text: Come closer, dearie, come closer, I do not bite. I have lived in these woods since before your grandmother was born, and I have seen things that would turn your hair white. Sit by the fire and I will tell you a story.
script: [cackling] Ehehe, a visitor! Come closer, dearie, I don't bite. [menacing, low] But the woods do. And they remember every name. [sad, wistful] I was lovely once, you know. Lovely as spring.

moods.calm: [calm, wry] Sit down, dearie. The kettle's on, and the night is young.
moods.joy: [cackling, gleeful] Ehehehe! Oh, that's the best news I've had in a hundred years!
moods.anger: [furious, hissing] Get out of my house, before I curse your bones to dust!
moods.fear: [frightened, quavering] No, no, it's coming. I can feel it in the roots. Run, child, run!
moods.sadness: [mournful, tired] They're all gone now, the ones I knew. Just me and the wind.

name: Orlen
description: A very old man, in his seventies or eighties, thin dry and wise, slow and thoughtful with a gentle amusement, an elderly wizard with a slight tremor of age. Warm, scholarly, British accent.
preview_text: Ah, there you are. I was beginning to think the tea would go cold. Sit down, my dear fellow, sit down. There are a great many things I must tell you, and I am afraid I have far less time to tell them than I once did.
script: [warm, amused] Ah, there you are. I was beginning to think the tea would go cold. [grave, urgent] Listen carefully, child. What sleeps beneath this tower must never wake. [weary, tender] I am old. Be brave for me.

moods.calm: [calm, kindly] Ah, good morning. Do sit. I was just reading about dragons.
moods.joy: [delighted, chuckling] Marvelous! It worked! Oh, I haven't felt this young in years!
moods.anger: [stern, thundering] Enough! You have no idea what you have unleashed upon this world!
moods.fear: [alarmed, shaking, thin elderly voice] By the stars... it has woken. We must leave, now, quickly!
moods.sadness: [sorrowful, soft, thin elderly voice] I have buried many good friends. I am tired of burying friends.

name: Brom
description: A gruff, stocky older man in his late fifties, very deep and gravelly with a strong Scottish burr, hearty and blunt, a dwarven blacksmith who shouts over the noise of the forge. Rough and warm.
preview_text: Aye, come in, come in, mind the sparks! I have been hammering since dawn and my throat is drier than the forge. If ye want a good blade ye'll pay a fair price, and nae haggling, ye hear me?
script: [booming, jolly] Ha! Another thirsty customer, aye? [furious] You call that a blade? I'd not use it to butter bread! [grudging respect, quiet] ...Fine. Fine. That's good steel. Bring me more.

moods.calm: [gruff, calm] Aye, I can have that blade ready by morning. Two silver, nae haggling, ye ken?
moods.joy: [roaring laughter] Ha ha! Now that's a proper ale, aye! Drinks are on me tonight, lads!
moods.anger: [furious, bellowing] Ye dare insult my forge?! I'll hammer ye flat, ye wee scunner!
moods.fear: [nervous, hushed, still gruff and deep] Och, there's something in the mine. I dinnae like it, lads. Quiet now.
moods.sadness: [low, heavy, deep] My brother's hammer. I couldnae lift it after he fell, aye. Still cannae.
moods.seductive: [gruff, warm, teasing] Och, now, ye've a way of makin' a dwarf forget his anvil, aye.

name: Seraphine
description: A confident woman in her early thirties, low smooth alto voice, slow, seductive but refined delivery, calm and knowing, a sorceress who enjoys making people nervous. Subtle British accent. Rich, controlled and intimate.
preview_text: Oh, don't look so worried, darling, I only want to talk. Sit, have some wine. You see, I have been watching you for quite some time now, and I think we could be very useful to one another.
script: [low, seductive] Oh, don't look so worried, darling. I only want to talk. [cold, cutting] But cross me again, and you'll learn what I truly am. [softly, tired] ...Even I get lonely, you know.

moods.calm: [calm, smooth] Good evening. Sit, and let me look at you. Don't be shy.
moods.joy: [amused, delighted] Oh, how wonderful. You actually did it. I'm almost impressed.
moods.anger: [cold fury, low] You will regret that. I promise you, darling, you will regret that.
moods.fear: [shaken, whispering] That power... it isn't mine. It's using me. Help me.
moods.sadness: [wistful, soft] I loved him once. Funny, how magic can't undo that.
moods.seductive: [low, seductive, slow] Come closer, darling. I promise I won't bite. Much.

name: Hettie
description: A warm, motherly woman in her late forties, slightly husky and cheerful, with a smile in her voice and an English countryside accent. Friendly, rounded and comforting, like a tavern landlady. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: Come in, come in, love, you'll catch your death out there! Sit down by the fire and I'll fetch you a bowl of stew. You look half starved, you poor thing.
script: [warm, cheerful] Come in, love, come in! Sit down by the fire. [stern, scolding] And mind my floors, or you'll be scrubbing them yourself! [soft, tender] There now. You look like you could use a hug.

moods.calm: [calm, friendly] Stew's on the table, love. Take as long as you like.
moods.joy: [delighted, laughing] Oh, bless you! That's the best news I've had all year!
moods.anger: [furious, sharp] Not in my inn, you don't! Out! Out, the lot of you!
moods.fear: [frightened, whispering] Did you hear that on the stairs? Lock the door, quick.
moods.sadness: [sad, tearful] My Albert used to sit just there. I still set his place.
moods.seductive: [playful, warm and teasing] Well now, aren't you a handsome one. Stay a while, love.

name: Lady Aldith
description: An aristocratic woman in her late thirties, crisp precise upper-class British Received Pronunciation, cool, composed and slightly haughty, measured pace. Refined, clear and polished. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: Good evening. I trust the journey was not too tiresome. Do sit down, we have a great deal to discuss, and I do dislike being kept waiting.
script: [cool, composed] Good evening. How very good of you to come. [icy, cutting] You will address me properly, or not at all. [quiet, vulnerable] ...I was not always this unkind.

moods.calm: [calm, polished] Do sit. The tea will be along presently.
moods.joy: [delighted, laughing lightly] Oh, how perfectly marvellous! I had quite given up hope!
moods.anger: [cold fury, clipped] How dare you. You forget whom you are addressing.
moods.fear: [trembling, hushed] They are inside the walls. Please, we must go. Now.
moods.sadness: [grieving, quiet] He promised he would return before the winter. It is nearly spring.
moods.seductive: [low, amused, intimate] You are staring, darling. Do go on; I rather like it.

name: Wren
description: A soft-spoken, timid woman in her early twenties, light, gentle and quiet, hesitant and sweet, a little breathy and nervous. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: Um, hello. I'm sorry to bother you. I was just wondering if you knew where the old bridge is? I think I'm a bit lost, and it's getting dark.
script: [shy, hesitant] Um... hello. I'm sorry, I didn't mean to bother you. [excited, breathless] Oh! Is that a real sword? That's amazing! [scared, small] Please don't tell my father I came here.

moods.calm: [quiet, gentle] It's all right. I like it here, it's quiet.
moods.joy: [bright, giggling] You remembered my name! Thank you, thank you so much!
moods.anger: [upset, voice cracking] That's not fair! You promised, and you broke it!
moods.fear: [terrified, tiny whisper] Something's behind the door. Please don't make me go in.
moods.sadness: [tearful, quiet] I miss my mother. She used to sing me to sleep.

name: Kestrel
description: A capable woman in her mid-thirties, steady low-mid voice, calm and no-nonsense, a ranger who speaks little and plainly, slight northern English accent. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: Keep your voice down and stay behind me. The tracks are fresh, which means whatever made them is close. If I say run, you run, understood?
script: [calm, low] Stay behind me. The tracks are fresh. [sharp, commanding] If I say run, you run. No questions. [soft, wry] ...You did well today. Don't let it go to your head.

moods.calm: [calm, steady] The wind's from the north. We should reach the ridge by dusk.
moods.joy: [warm, laughing] Ha! Got it! First shot, did you see that?
moods.anger: [cold, controlled anger] You were told to wait. People die when orders are ignored.
moods.fear: [tense, whispering] Don't move. It's right above us. Slowly, now.
moods.sadness: [quiet, heavy] I tracked her for three days. I was too late.
moods.seductive: [low, amused, warm] Careful. A girl could get used to having you around.

name: Pip
description: A cheeky young woman in her mid-twenties, fast playful voice, street-smart and sarcastic with a grin in it, a light cockney London accent. Quick, bright and mischievous. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: Oh, you didn't want me to take it? Funny, because it's in my pocket now. Relax, I'm only teasing. Mostly. Come on, I know a shortcut, and no, it isn't legal.
script: [cheeky, grinning] Oh, this old thing? Finders keepers, mate! [alarmed, fast] Guards! Run, run, run! [quiet, honest] ...Nobody ever waited for me before. Thanks.

moods.calm: [relaxed, casual] Nah, it's quiet tonight. Even the rats are asleep.
moods.joy: [gleeful, laughing] Ha! Did you see his face? Priceless! Drinks are on him!
moods.anger: [snarling, angry] You sold me out! After everything, you rotten, lying snake!
moods.fear: [panicked, whispering fast] They've found us, they've found us. Go, go, go!
moods.sadness: [small, tired] Everyone I grew up with is gone. It's just me now.
moods.seductive: [playful, sultry, teasing] Hey there, handsome. Want to see what else I can steal?

name: Sir Aldric
description: A strong man in his late thirties, deep resonant heroic voice, steady and honourable, measured pace like a knight, a British accent. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: Stand behind me. I swore an oath to protect this town, and I intend to keep it, whatever it costs. Whoever dares to threaten you must first face my sword.
script: [noble, resolute] Stand behind me. No harm will come to you while I draw breath. [furious, thundering] Face me, coward, and answer for your crimes! [gentle, weary] ...I am tired, my friend. But I will not yield.

moods.calm: [calm, dignified] The road is clear, and the horses are rested. We ride at dawn.
moods.joy: [hearty, laughing] Ha ha! Well fought, my friend! Come, the first round is mine!
moods.anger: [cold fury, booming] You dishonour this hall and every oath sworn within it!
moods.fear: [grave, hushed] Hold the line. It is larger than I thought. Steady, now.
moods.sadness: [heavy, quiet] I carried him from the field myself. He was only a boy.
moods.seductive: [low, warm, intimate] Forgive my staring. It is not every day I forget my duty.

name: Barnaby
description: A jolly heavyset man in his fifties, booming warm laughing voice, loud and friendly, a tavern keeper, English accent. Rounded and generous. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: Welcome, welcome, one and all! Pull up a stool, the ale is cold and the stew is hot, and the first round is on the house for anyone who can tell a decent joke!
script: [booming, jolly] Welcome, welcome! The first round's on the house! [furious, shouting] Oi! Not in my tavern! Take it outside! [soft, sentimental] ...You lot are the best family a fat old barkeep could ask for.

moods.calm: [relaxed, genial] Slow night. Pour yourself one, I'll polish the mugs.
moods.joy: [roaring laughter] Ha ha ha! Best joke I've heard in years! Another round!
moods.anger: [bellowing, furious] Who broke my barrel?! Speak up, or you're all banned!
moods.fear: [nervous, hushed] Keep it down, lads. Those cloaked fellows in the corner. I don't like their look.
moods.sadness: [low, wistful] The old place was always louder, back when she was alive.
moods.seductive: [warm, playful, rumbling] Ah, don't mind me, I'm just a big softie. Stay for another, eh?

name: Tam
description: A young-sounding eager man, boyish, earnest and a little high and quick, enthusiastic and slightly nervous, an apprentice squire. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: Sir, sir! I polished your armour twice, and I fed the horses, and I sharpened the sword just like you showed me. Can I come with you this time? Please?
script: [eager, excited] Sir, sir! I polished your armour twice! Can I come? [angry, cracking] I'm not a boy! I can fight, I swear it! [small, scared] ...I'm really glad you're here. It's dark.

moods.calm: [earnest, steady] Yes, sir. The horses are fed and the gear is packed.
moods.joy: [thrilled, laughing] You said I did well? Really? Wait till I tell my mother!
moods.anger: [upset, shouting] That's not fair, sir! I did exactly what you said!
moods.fear: [terrified, whispering] There's something in the trees, sir. I heard it breathing.
moods.sadness: [tearful, quiet] I wanted to be like him. Now he's gone, and I'm still just a squire.

name: Silas
description: A smooth sly man in his mid-thirties, relaxed amused silky voice, charming and slightly dangerous, a roguish merchant, soft British accent. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: Ah, there you are. I was starting to think you had lost your nerve. Relax, friend, have a drink, and let me tell you about a little opportunity that happens to involve a great deal of gold.
script: [smooth, amused] Ah, there you are. Do sit, I've been expecting you. [cold, threatening] Cross me once more, and the river will have you. [quiet, honest] ...You know, I almost like you. Almost.

moods.calm: [relaxed, silky] Everything is arranged. All you need to do is smile.
moods.joy: [delighted, chuckling] Beautiful! Oh, that went better than I dared hope!
moods.anger: [low, cold fury] You stole from me. Nobody steals from me twice.
moods.fear: [tense, whispering] Guards. Two of them, maybe three. Don't turn around.
moods.sadness: [quiet, regretful] I had a brother, once. We were both fools.
moods.seductive: [low, velvety, seductive] Well now. If I'd known you'd be here, I'd have worn something nicer.

name: Captain Rook
description: A stern man in his mid-forties, hard authoritative voice, clipped and commanding, a guard captain, rough English accent. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: Listen up. The gate closes at dusk, and nobody comes in or out without my say-so. If you see anything suspicious, you report it to me directly. Is that clear?
script: [commanding, clipped] Listen up. Nobody passes without my word. [furious, barking] Draw your weapon, soldier! Now! [quiet, grave] ...Good people died today. Remember their names.

moods.calm: [calm, firm] All quiet on the wall. Keep your eyes open all the same.
moods.joy: [rare, gruff laughter] Ha! Well done, lads. Don't let it go to your heads.
moods.anger: [barking, furious] I said hold the line! Who gave the order to retreat?!
moods.fear: [tense, low] They outnumber us three to one. Hold steady. Hold steady.
moods.sadness: [hoarse, quiet] I wrote to forty families this winter. I'm tired of writing.
moods.seductive: [low, gruff, restrained] Don't mistake me. I notice a good deal more than I let on.

name: Hob
description: A gentle middle-aged farmer in his forties, slow warm country voice, a rural West Country English accent, mild and kind. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: Ah, mornin' to ye. Fine day for plantin', this. Rain's been kind this year, and the turnips are comin' up nicely. Ye're welcome to a bite of bread if ye're passin' by.
script: [warm, slow] Mornin' to ye. Fine day for plantin'. [angry, gruff] Get yer hands off me cattle! I'll not say it twice! [quiet, content] ...Aye. It's a good life, simple as it is.

moods.calm: [slow, easy] Rain's comin', I reckon. Best bring the sheep in.
moods.joy: [delighted, chuckling] Well, I'll be! Best harvest in twenty year!
moods.anger: [gruff, furious] Ye let the fox into the coop?! Me whole winter's eggs!
moods.fear: [hushed, uneasy] Summat's been at the sheep. Big tracks. Stay close, now.
moods.sadness: [low, quiet] The old dog's gone. Fifteen year she walked this field with me.
moods.seductive: [shy, warm, teasing] Well, now. Ye've a smile that'd turn the milk sweet.

name: Pellam
description: A nervous bookish man in his mid-twenties, thin fussy voice, quick and anxious, a scribe and scholar, English accent. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: Oh, hello! Um, mind the stack by your left foot, those are first editions. I was just cataloguing the ancient maps, and I think I have found something rather peculiar in the margins.
script: [nervous, fussy] Oh! Mind the books, please, those are first editions! [excited, fast] But look, look, this proves everything! [small, afraid] ...You will keep this secret, won't you?

moods.calm: [mild, precise] The archive closes at six. I shall put the kettle on.
moods.joy: [thrilled, stammering] It's real! The manuscript is real! Oh, I could weep!
moods.anger: [indignant, squeaking] You burned it! Four hundred years of scholarship, and you burned it!
moods.fear: [panicked, whispering] It's moving. The statue's moving. Oh no, oh no.
moods.sadness: [quiet, soft] Nobody comes to the library now. Just me and the dust.
moods.seductive: [flustered, shy, charming] Oh. I, um. You do have a rather lovely way of looking at a person.

name: Mordrake
description: A cold menacing man in his mid-forties, quiet low voice, slow and deliberate, sinister calm, a necromancer, refined British accent. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: Do not be afraid. Fear is such a clumsy thing. I only wish to understand how long you will take to stop breathing, and whether you will beg first.
script: [cold, quiet] Do not be afraid. I only wish to understand you. [menacing, low] Kneel, and I may let you live a little longer. [softly, almost sad] ...Death is not an ending, you know. It is a doorway.

moods.calm: [calm, silky] Everything proceeds exactly as I intended.
moods.joy: [chilling, soft laugh] Ah. At last. How long I have waited for this moment.
moods.anger: [cold fury, hissing] You dare defy me in my own hall? I will unmake you.
moods.fear: [shaken, suppressed] Impossible. It should not be here. Stand back. Stand back!
moods.sadness: [low, hollow] I buried her myself. And still she will not rest.
moods.seductive: [low, velvet, menacing] Come closer. I have so rarely had such pleasant company.

name: King Edric
description: An older man in his early sixties, grand resonant commanding voice, weary but regal, a king addressing his court, deep, rich British accent. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: My people, we gather tonight in a time of great peril. The winter has been long, and the enemy is at our gates, but I will not abandon this kingdom, nor any one of you.
script: [grand, resonant] My people, hear your king! We will not yield! [furious, thundering] Traitor! Bring him before me in chains! [weary, gentle] ...Forgive an old man. The crown grows heavy.

moods.calm: [calm, regal] Rise, all of you. Let us hear what the council has decided.
moods.joy: [warm, booming laughter] Splendid! Let the bells ring, let the whole kingdom celebrate!
moods.anger: [thundering, furious] Silence! Who dares speak against the crown in this hall?!
moods.fear: [grave, strained] The walls will not hold. Send the children north, at once.
moods.sadness: [hollow, quiet] I sent him to that war myself. My son, my only son.

name: Veil
description: A mysterious hooded stranger, hushed whispery androgynous voice, calm and cryptic, soft and low, uncertain age around thirty. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: You are looking for something, aren't you? Everyone who comes this way is. I can tell you where it is, but the answer will cost you more than gold.
script: [hushed, cryptic] You are looking for something, aren't you? [sharp, whispered threat] Follow me no further, or you will not like what I show you. [soft, sad] ...I was like you, once.

moods.calm: [calm, whispery] The path is quiet tonight. That is not always good.
moods.joy: [soft, delighted laugh] Oh. So it worked. How very delightful.
moods.anger: [low, hissing fury] You were warned. Everything that follows is on your head.
moods.fear: [trembling, whispering] It saw me. It knows my name. Run.
moods.sadness: [faint, aching] There was a house, once. There was a window with a light.
moods.seductive: [low, whispery, intimate] Come closer. I only bite when asked.

name: The Hollow One
description: A hollow, rasping undead being, like a risen skeleton lich or a corpse: a dry, whispering, echoing voice with a deep rattling breath, grave-cold, slow and menacing, ancient and rotting, hissing sibilants, inhuman. Male. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: You have come to my tomb. Long have I slept beneath the stones. Now I hunger for the warmth of your living breath.
script: [hollow, rasping whisper] You have come to my tomb. [snarling, rotting] Join us! Join us in the dark! [mournful, ghostly] ...So cold. I remember being warm.

moods.calm: [hollow, slow] The dead are patient. We have all the time in the world.
moods.joy: [cold, rasping laugh] Heh heh heh. Another soul for the grave. Delicious.
moods.anger: [snarling, echoing] Who disturbs my rest?! I will rip the marrow from your bones!
moods.fear: [rasping, shaken] The light. It burns. Back! Keep it back!
moods.sadness: [mournful, ghostly] I had a name once. I cannot remember it.

name: Ashmaw
description: A colossal ancient dragon: an extremely deep, booming, resonant voice with a growling rumble in the chest, slow, majestic and imperious, theatrical British accent, rumbling bass, vast and powerful, with a hint of amusement and menace. Male. Clean studio recording.
preview_text: So. A mortal dares to walk into my hall. How very brave, and how very foolish. I have burned kingdoms to ash for less than this.
script: [booming, imperious] So. A mortal dares to enter my hall. [roaring, furious] I will burn this kingdom to ash! [low, amused rumble] ...Tell me, little thief, what makes you think you can win?

moods.calm: [deep, slow, rumbling] Sit, little one. I am old, and I am in a talkative mood.
moods.joy: [booming laughter] Ha ha ha! Delightful! It has been centuries since I was this entertained!
moods.anger: [roaring, thunderous] You dare steal from me?! I will melt the flesh from your bones!
moods.fear: [low, shaken rumble] No. That blade. It cannot be. Keep it away from me!
moods.sadness: [deep, mournful] I was the last of my kind. Now only silence fills these halls.
